visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a silver spoon drizzling dark brown sauce over pan-seared mackerel fillets on a white textured plate. Transition to a male chef in a white uniform standing in a studio with a grey brick wall background. He gestures with his hands while speaking enthusiastically. (2) Top-down view of a raw mackerel fillet on a light wooden cutting board. A hand wearing a clear plastic glove uses a stainless steel kitchen knife to cut the fish into three even pieces. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the fish scales. (3) The chef holds a bottle of dark soy sauce branded 'Hei Dou Sang' with a green and gold label. He pours the liquid into a clear glass bowl on a wooden table. Other ingredients like ginger paste and white sugar are added and mixed with wooden chopsticks. (4) A hand pours clear oil into a white ceramic frying pan on a black portable stove. The fish pieces are placed skin-side down, sizzling in the oil. The chef flips them, showing a golden-brown crust, then pours the prepared sauce over them to simmer. (5) The finished fish is plated with a garnish of shredded green onions and a sprinkle of white sesame seeds. The chef appears again, concluding his presentation. The final frame shows the brand logo '料理123' in bold white text on a black background.

(6) [Slogan]: 食材. [Slogan]: 黑豆桑厚黑金醬油 50ml. [Slogan]: 黑豆桑蘋果淳 20g. [Slogan]: 薑泥 10g. [Slogan]: 糖 5g. [Slogan]: 清酒 90ml. [Slogan]: 水 30ml. (7) [Subtitle]: 接著先來製作醬汁. (8) [Logo]: 黑豆桑.
